description: Reports and controls the pull request gate (gatekeepers/pr) for the core_dump GitHub repository: whether its service is running, and for each open PR whether it is blocked (build, tests, documentation, or a quiz waiting, with its link) or may merge. With action start, stop or restart it controls the gate's own service (pr-gate) and nothing else; stopping it never lets a change merge.

params.name: action
params.description: status (default), start, stop or restart the gate's service

params.name: pr
params.description: Only this pull request number; omit it for every open PR
